title: Club Growth Path
description: Four growth stages on one timeline, each with the single condition that has to be true before a club moves on, plus a marker to bookmark where you actually are.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Growing, Branding, and Promoting Your Club

educational.audience: Club founders and leaders planning beyond the first year

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a club's current size and stability, the learner identifies which growth stage it occupies and what condition must be met before advancing to the next stage.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore stage timeline with a draggable self-placement marker
pedagogical.assessment: Describe a club in prose and ask which stage it occupies and what must be true before it advances.
